name: Cryo DMG
description:
Applies Cryo and can trigger the following Elemental Reactions:
Every 1 Elemental Mastery increases the specified effect by a factor of 1
Melt: DMG +100% for this instance, with every 8 Elemental Mastery contributing an additional 100%
Superconduct: Apply 1 stack of Frostbite to all opposing characters
Frozen: Apply 4 stacks of Frostbite to the target
